name: smwgraphics-frog-statues-trophies
title: Frog Statues / Trophies
description:
If you want to put a kind of reward or decorate your hack/level, this graphic can be useful! It's just a statue or trophie with a frog at the top, containing gold (1st), silver (2st) and bronze (3st) versions. The map16 has a act as 25 (blank) version and a act as 106 (cloud) version.

Uses the blank half of rows 5, 6 and 7. If you want, you can use the holders for other graphics. Ah, and you can set the palettes for any number in map16, like gold palette for holder with number 3.

Actually I wanted koopas, but the result was a random frog as you can see. Credits aren't required but I'd like.
